programme.title: In lockdown
programme.desc: Former lecturer Jefferson Grieff (Stanley Tucci) is on death row for murdering his wife.People who need help in criminal matters come to him.One day, a journalist interested in the interview, Beth Davenport (Lydia West), pays him a visit.The reporter has recently met Janice Fife (Dolly Wells).Right after their meeting, she was locked in the basement of vicar Harry Watling (David Tennant).A priest imprisoned his son's tutor to protect him from false accusations of pedophilia.This is how the fates of several people from completely different worlds come together.

programme.title: My Family 3
programme.desc: Ben (Robert Lindsay) and Susan (Zoë Wanamaker) Harper are a middle-class couple living in the Chiswick district of London.Their three children live with them: Nick (Kris Marshall), Janey (Daniela Denby-Ashe) and Michael (Gabriel Thomson).Ben is a dentist who values ​​peace and quiet.Susan makes all the important decisions in the family.She works in London as a tour guide and has a hard time adapting to the stereotype of a woman cooking dinner for her husband.The eldest son, Nick, is not very bright, has problems finding a permanent job and spends most of his time in front of the TV.Janey is only interested in clothes and boys, and the youngest, Michael, is an intelligent boy and the mascot of the whole family.He doesn't find a common language with his father, but spends all day in front of the computer.

programme.title: Father Brown
programme.desc: Christmas is coming.The bishop's emissary tells Father Brown that this year the feast is to be held according to tradition.For some time, everything goes according to the wishes of the inhabitants of the parsonage.Problems begin when Mrs. McCarthy finds homeless Michael sleeping in the confessional and the man ends up under Father Brown's roof.Soon, further complications appear - the choir members succumb to laryngitis, the borrowed donkey disappears, and the girl who was supposed to play the role of Mary ends up in hospital with a concussion.Despite this, the parish priest does not lose hope that the bad fate will turn around.

programme.title: Blue Lights 2
programme.desc: Grace (Sian Brooke), Annie (Katherine Devlin) and Tommy (Nathan Braniff) are on duty in Belfast.They quickly discover that no training will prepare them for what they have to face - reality can be much more demanding and unpredictable.A year has passed since the dismantling of the McIntyre gang, but the vacuum left behind is immediately filled with new groups fighting for dominance.As tensions mount, the team is joined by Constable Shane Bradley (Frank Blake), whose intentions raise doubts among his colleagues.When a young loyalist begins to destabilize the fragile balance in the city, the police face the specter of a brutal confrontation.Their personal lives are equally turbulent.Tommy is considering going into intelligence more and more seriously, and Grace is struggling with missing her son and the feelings she begins to bond with one of the officers.
